text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD-84721 — service=rt-router — threshold breach: 95th latency spike x3 in 6m, auto-escalation in 2m if unacked

maria: acked. Oncall Maria taking. Looking at dashboard now.

dan: saw the spike too. Router CPU high on canary-2, concurrent connections jumped. No obvious error traces.

maria: grabbing logs from canary-2, running `curl` against /health and /metrics to confirm behavior.

jena: i silenced the PD noise for 10m to stop wakeups while investigating (`/pd silence PD-84721 10m`) :zipper_mouth_face:

incident-bot: PD note: escalation suppressed for 10m due to manual silence.

maria: logs show a short KV warmup loop — sudden cache misses + a spike of synthetic traffic from canary job. snippet:

```
2026-03-15T12:03:21Z router.go:312 WARN prefix-miss: key_count=0 -> warmup triggered
2026-03-15T12:03:22Z metrics.go:45 gauge(router_cpu)=92
2026-03-15T12:03:24Z synth-check: request_rate=120/s (expected 20/s)
```

dan: that synth job was redeployed ~2m ago as part of canary run. Looks like its request rate misconfig blew up.

maria: restarting canary-2 ingress to drop the surge. `k run` complete, monitoring.

jena: any customer-facing alerts? monitoring shows no 5xx spike for customers. only internal canary buckets. :white_check_mark:

maria: routing latency returning to baseline in the graph. CPU down to 40%.

incident-bot: PD-84721 auto-resolved (duration 7m) — reason: alert cleared by suppression/silence before escalation.

kevin: taking 2nd look during handoff. Noted that incidentbot flapped 3x in short window before silence.

maria: summary: transient synthetic load from misconfigured canary caused short-lived router CPU/latency spike, no customer impact, manual silence applied, canary restarted.

dan: mitigation actions: 1) patch synth job to enforce rate limit (jenkins/job#238). 2) adjust alert policy to require node-level corroboration before PD paging (reduce sensitivity of single synthetic bucket). 3) add runbook step for quick canary drain.

jena: filing follow-up tickets now. assigning to infra and devex for canary fix.

maria: handing off to kevin for postmortem + verify follow-ups. oncall handover: please watch for recurrence in next 2 hours and re-open if needed.

kevin: thanks — i'll own the follow-up, will check the suppress rules and PD escalation policy. tagging product-alerting.

maria: closing thread, no customer impact, suggest lowering synthetic alert priority from P0->P2. :thumbsup:

jena: pledge: add a safety rate limiter to all synthetic canaries in the pipeline by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: noted. i'll update the alerting playbook with a short blurb about transient canary flaps.

incident-bot: log: participants_ack=[maria], silence_applied_by=jena, auto_resolved=true, duration=420s

maria: thanks everyone. moving this to post-incident review if we see any repeats. :coffee:
